Restart a stopped VM

Usage: iso start [OPTIONS] [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]  Stopped instance name (optional only when exactly one stopped instance exists)

Options:
      --workspace <WORKSPACE>        Project directory used to select an associated stopped instance
      --no-agents                    Skip injecting Claude Code and Codex credentials/config into the VM
      --no-github                    Use github = "off" for this invocation and skip the GitHub PAT prompt
      --forward-port <FORWARD_PORT>  Forward a guest port to the host (`GUEST[:HOST]`, repeatable). `--forward-port 3000` forwards guest 3000 to host 3000; `--forward-port 3000:3001` forwards guest 3000 to host 3001
      --no-prompt                    Suppress the interactive prompt to set up a scoped GitHub PAT when one is missing for the resolved repo
      --post-start <CMD>             Shell command to run inside the guest after boot (overrides `post_start` from `config.toml`). Failure is logged but does not fail the start
      --env <KEY=VALUE>              Literal env var to set in the guest (`KEY=VALUE`, repeatable). Overrides `guest_env` entries from config and any forwarded values with the same name
      --devcontainer <PATH>          Explicit path to a `devcontainer.json` to use (skips discovery)
      --no-devcontainer              Ignore any discovered `devcontainer.json` (escape hatch for CI)
      --dry-run                      Translate `devcontainer.json` and print the report, then exit before doing any VM work
      --json                         With --dry-run, emit the resolved plan as JSON on stdout
  -h, --help                         Print help
